parsed.note_claim: Numerous fact checks debunked the claims made here regarding USAID funding Chelsea Clinton.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Ruling False. Chelsea Clinton did not receive any compensation for her work at the foundation since at least the fiscal year ending December 2013. The claim that USAID provided the $84 million in funding is also incorrect.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly rules the claim as false and states USAID did not provide the alleged funding.
